scheme_name: Construction of Dudhghar/ Godown (Scheduled Caste Area)
other_conditions: Must be a registered Village Milk Producer Co-operative Society.
Must be located in Scheduled Caste areas of Gujarat.
Must not already own a Dudhghar or Godown.
Must have its own land available for construction of the Dudhghar or Godown.
Must not have availed the benefit earlier under this or any other scheme for a similar purpose.
benefits_summary: Up to 50% of the construction cost, capped at ₹5,00,000, payable once in the society’s lifetime.
